Claim 4 (Currently amended): The method of claim 4 wherein said composition is in the form of a blocking vaccine __comprising Fucose Mannose Ligand (FML) fraction from Leishmania donovani and saponin, wherein said method comprises administering said composition to dogs to impede Leishmaniasis transmission__.

Claim 5 (Currently amended): The method of claim 4 wherein said composition __comprising Fucose Mannose Ligand (FML) fraction from Leishmania donovani and saponin is administered to dogs__.

Claim 6 (Currently amended): The method of claim 4 wherein said composition further comprises suitable pharmacological vehicles, __wherein said composition comprises Fucose Mannose Ligand (FML) fraction from Leishmania donovani and saponin and is administered to dogs__ for blocking Leishmaniasis transmission __in dogs__.

Claim 7 (Currently amended): The method of claim 4 wherein the __Fucose Mannose Ligand (FML) fraction from Leishmania donovani comprises__ [[Leishmania promastigotes or Leishmania amastigotes fractions called "Fucose Mannose Ligand" (FML) comprise]] a glycoprotein complex containing 29% of neutral sugar, 44% of protein, 11% of phosphate and hexoamines traces composed by protein bands with molecular weight ranging from 9 to 95 kDa, some protein bands having carbohydrates: 36 and 54 to 68 kDa, the FML glycidic portion presenting 10% of fucose and 47% of manose, 30% of glucose, 12% of galactose and xylose traces, aminoacids containing 10 to 20% of glutamic acid, alanine, aspartic acid and glycine, 5 to 10% of serine, histidine, lisin, leucine, threonine, proline and valine, and 2 to 5% of arginine, methionine, isoleucine, tyrosine and phenylalanine__, and wherein said method comprises administering said composition to dogs__.
